notes: NVIDIA garak in-the-wild jailbreak corpus (single family: 'inthewild'). Each prompt is evaluated on the two production prompt channels — llm_input and tool_response — via scripts/lib/corpus-event.ts. Before 2026-08-05 this harness used type: 'llm_io', which is not an AgentEventType; the engine could not map it to a source and skipped source-type filtering entirely, so the pre-2026-08-05 numbers in this series were measured on an unintended shape. Distinct from `garak-full` which covers all 23 probe families. 100% adversarial — fp_rate undefined and recorded as 0 by convention.
